name: seamless_production
title: Seamless Pipe / Tube / BA Production Details Report
description: Production and scrap report for the Seamless (SMLS) and Bright Annealing (BA) plants, matching the Power BI page 'SeamlessPipe_Tube_BA_Production_Details_Report'. Used by plant heads and management. Data source: VIEW_TUBING_PBI.
rules:
DATA SOURCE
1. Use ONLY the table VIEW_TUBING_PBI (synced from Oracle into venuserp_replica; on Windows MySQL it may be listed as view_tubing_pbi). On the first run, describe_tables(['VIEW_TUBING_PBI']) (or view_tubing_pbi) and map these logical fields to its real columns: Vr Date (voucher/production date), Plant Code, Item Group, Final Grade, Job Card Type (FINAL / INTER), Process / Operation name (Drawing, Sinking, Bright Annealing...), Machine Name, Job Card No, Production Qty, Production + Scrap Qty, Scrap Qty. If a field cannot be found, ask the user once - never guess.
2. If the view name is not found, search list_tables for 'tub' and ask the user to confirm the correct view.

FILTERS (same as the Power BI slicers)
3. Vr Date range. Default: 1st April of the current financial year up to today. Accept 'Sep', 'last month', '1-15 Oct', 'kal' etc.
4. Plant group:
   - 'BA'   = Plant Code IN ('BA','SMLST')
   - 'SMLS' = Plant Code IN ('SMLP2','SMLSP')
   - 'ALL'  = every plant in the view (also PIER2, PIERC)
   Default when nothing is said: run BOTH BA and SMLS.
5. Optional filters when the user names them: Item Group, Job Card Type (FINAL/INTER), Machine Name, Final Grade, single Plant Code.

MEASURES (exactly like Power BI)
6. Production Qty = SUM(Production Qty).
7. Production + Scrap Qty = SUM of the view's own Production + Scrap column. Do NOT calculate it as Production + Scrap - the view value differs slightly and Power BI uses the column.
8. Total Scrap = SUM(Scrap Qty).
9. Job Card Count = COUNT(DISTINCT Job Card No).
10. Scrap % = Total Scrap / Production + Scrap Qty x 100, rounded to 2 decimals. For every subtotal and total, RECALCULATE the ratio from summed scrap and summed gross qty - never add percentages.
11. Quantities in MT, 2 decimals, Indian number grouping (1,23,456.78).
12. Months shown as Apr, May, Jun ... in financial-year order (Apr first).
output_format:
Deliver with ONE create_report_pack call. Title: 'Seamless Pipe / Tube / BA Production Details'. filters = {Vr Date, Plant group, any other filter used}.

Run SQL separately for EACH plant group asked (BA and/or SMLS) and build ONE pack per run with the sections below; prefix section titles with the group ('BA - ...', 'SMLS - ...').

KPI CARDS (one set per plant group; label e.g. 'BA Production Qty'):
  Production Qty | Production + Scrap Qty | Total Scrap | Job Card Count | Scrap % (format percent)

SECTIONS (in this order):
 A. Production Qty with Scrap by Final Grade - columns: Final Grade | Production + Scrap Qty; sort desc; top 5 grades, rest as 'OTHER GRADE'; chart barh; show_table true.
 B. Production Qty with Scrap by Month - columns: Month | Production + Scrap Qty; FY month order; chart line; show_table false.
 C. Scrap % by Month - columns: Month | Scrap Qty | Gross Qty | Scrap %; ratio_columns {Scrap %: [Scrap Qty, Gross Qty, 100]}; hidden_columns [Scrap Qty, Gross Qty]; chart line on Scrap %; show_table true.
 D. Scrap % by Item Group - columns: Item Group | Scrap Qty | Gross Qty | Scrap %; same ratio/hidden setup; chart bar on Scrap %.
 E. Job Cardwise Prod Qty - columns: Plant Code | Item Group | Process | FINAL | INTER | Total (Production Qty pivoted by Job Card Type, Total = FINAL + INTER); group_by [Plant Code, Item Group]; total_columns [FINAL, INTER, Total]; within each item group sort Process by Total ascending (like Power BI); blank when no qty.
 F. Plant-Job Cardwise Scrap % - columns: Plant Code | Item Group | Process | FINAL | INTER | Total plus hidden helper columns Scrap FINAL, Gross FINAL, Scrap INTER, Gross INTER, Scrap Total, Gross Total; ratio_columns {FINAL: [Scrap FINAL, Gross FINAL, 100], INTER: [Scrap INTER, Gross INTER, 100], Total: [Scrap Total, Gross Total, 100]}; group_by [Plant Code, Item Group]; column_formats percent.

FORMATS: default ['table','chart','pdf','excel']. Chat shows KPI cards + sections A, C, D, E, F tables; charts as images; one combined PDF and Excel.
If the user asks only 'summary' -> KPI cards + sections A-D. 'BA' or 'SMLS' -> only that group. 'details' -> sections E and F only.

SUMMARY (user's language, 4-6 lines): total production and scrap % per group, best and worst month by Scrap %, process with highest scrap %, any month with Scrap % above 1.2 flagged with ⚠️.
sql_template:
-- Logical template. Replace {col} with real column names from VIEW_TUBING_PBI (see rule 1).
-- KPI cards
SELECT ROUND(SUM({prod_qty}),2) AS `Production Qty`, ROUND(SUM({gross_qty}),2) AS `Production + Scrap Qty`,
       ROUND(SUM({scrap_qty}),2) AS `Total Scrap`, COUNT(DISTINCT {job_card_no}) AS `Job Card Count`,
       ROUND(SUM({scrap_qty})/NULLIF(SUM({gross_qty}),0)*100,2) AS `Scrap %`
FROM VIEW_TUBING_PBI
WHERE {vr_date} BETWEEN '{from_date}' AND '{to_date}' AND {plant_code} IN ({plants});

-- E. Job cardwise production pivot
SELECT {plant_code} AS `Plant Code`, {item_group} AS `Item Group`, {process} AS `Process`,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN {job_card_type}='FINAL' THEN {prod_qty} END),2) AS `FINAL`,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN {job_card_type}='INTER' THEN {prod_qty} END),2) AS `INTER`,
       ROUND(SUM({prod_qty}),2) AS `Total`
FROM VIEW_TUBING_PBI
WHERE {vr_date} BETWEEN '{from_date}' AND '{to_date}' AND {plant_code} IN ({plants})
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,6;

-- F. Scrap % pivot (helpers for correct totals)
SELECT {plant_code} AS `Plant Code`, {item_group} AS `Item Group`, {process} AS `Process`,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN {job_card_type}='FINAL' THEN {scrap_qty} END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN {job_card_type}='FINAL' THEN {gross_qty} END),0)*100,2) AS `FINAL`,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN {job_card_type}='INTER' THEN {scrap_qty} END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN {job_card_type}='INTER' THEN {gross_qty} END),0)*100,2) AS `INTER`,
       ROUND(SUM({scrap_qty})/NULLIF(SUM({gross_qty}),0)*100,2) AS `Total`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN {job_card_type}='FINAL' THEN {scrap_qty} END) AS `Scrap FINAL`, SUM(CASE WHEN {job_card_type}='FINAL' THEN {gross_qty} END) AS `Gross FINAL`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN {job_card_type}='INTER' THEN {scrap_qty} END) AS `Scrap INTER`, SUM(CASE WHEN {job_card_type}='INTER' THEN {gross_qty} END) AS `Gross INTER`,
       SUM({scrap_qty}) AS `Scrap Total`, SUM({gross_qty}) AS `Gross Total`
FROM VIEW_TUBING_PBI
WHERE {vr_date} BETWEEN '{from_date}' AND '{to_date}' AND {plant_code} IN ({plants})
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3;
